about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Chicken 65 Chennai Fried Chicken
recipes.summary: Crisp, fiery fried chicken bites from Chennai, tossed with green chilli and lemon.

items: 600g boneless chicken thigh, cut into 3cm pieces

steps: Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, cornflour, rice flour, ginger, garlic, chilli powder, garam masala and salt until coated.
Heat the oil in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the chicken in 2 batches for 6 minutes each, turning, until deep red-gold and crisp.
Drop the green chillies into the pan for 30 seconds until blistered.
Toss the chicken with the chillies and serve hot with lemon wedges.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches at least 75°C at the thickest part. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 30 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Malai Tikka Creamy Chicken Skewers
recipes.summary: Mild, creamy chicken tikka scented with cardamom and white pepper, roasted until lightly charred.

items: 700g chicken thigh fillets, cut into 4cm pieces

steps: Mix the chicken with the cream, yoghurt, ginger, garlic, cardamom, pepper, salt and lemon juice.
Thread onto skewers and brush with the ghee.
Roast at 230C on a rack over a tray for 18 minutes, turning once, until lightly charred at the edges.
Warm the naan and serve with the tikka and sliced onion.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach at least 75°C at the thickest part. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 1 hour marinating.

recipes.title: Hariyali Chicken Tikka Green Herb Skewers
recipes.summary: Chicken tikka in a bright mint, coriander and spinach marinade, grilled until fragrant and juicy.

items: 700g chicken thigh fillets, cut into 4cm pieces

steps: Blend the coriander, mint, spinach, chillies, yoghurt, ginger, garlic, lemon juice, garam masala and salt to a smooth paste.
Coat the chicken in the paste and thread onto skewers.
Brush with the oil and grill or roast at 230C for 18 minutes, turning once, until charred in spots.
Serve hot with extra lemon.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach at least 75°C at the thickest part. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 1 hour marinating.

recipes.title: Reshmi Kebab Silky Cashew Chicken
recipes.summary: Silky, golden chicken kebabs in a cashew and cream marinade, grilled and served with warm naan.

items: 700g chicken thigh fillets, cut into 4cm pieces

steps: Blend the soaked cashews with the cream, yoghurt, ginger, garlic, cumin, cardamom and salt until smooth.
Coat the chicken in the paste and thread onto skewers.
Roast at 230C for 18 minutes, turning once and brushing with the butter, until golden and cooked through.
Warm the naan and serve with the kebabs and lemon.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach at least 75°C at the thickest part. Contains tree nuts, gluten and milk. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 1 hour marinating.

recipes.title: Galouti Kebab Lucknow Melting Lamb Patties
recipes.summary: Lucknowi lamb patties so tender they melt, spiced with fried onion and cardamom and pan-fried in ghee.
steps: Fry the onions in 1 tbsp ghee for 12 minutes until deep brown and crisp, then crush them.
Mix the lamb with the onions, ginger, garlic, spices, toasted chickpea flour and salt, kneading for 3 minutes until very smooth.
Shape into 12 small flat patties about 1.5cm thick.
Pan-fry in the remaining ghee over medium heat for 4 minutes each side until browned and cooked through.
Serve on the warm flatbreads with the mint chutney.
notes: Food safety: cook the patties right through to at least 75°C; mince carries bacteria throughout. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 30 minutes chilling.

recipes.title: Amritsari Machhi Punjabi Fried Fish
recipes.summary: Chickpea-flour-coated fish pieces spiced with ajwain and chilli, shallow-fried until crisp, a Punjabi street classic.

items: 600g firm white fish fillets, cut into 4cm pieces

steps: Toss the fish with the ginger, garlic, chilli powder, salt and lemon juice.
Mix the chickpea flour with the ajwain and enough water for a thick batter, then coat the fish.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat and fry the fish in batches for 3 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Drain on paper and serve with the onion and mint chutney.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C. Contains fish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 20 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Meen Varuthathu Kerala Fried Fish with Rice
recipes.summary: Kingfish steaks rubbed with chilli, turmeric and pepper and shallow-fried in coconut oil, served with rice.
steps: Rub the fish with the chilli powder, turmeric, pepper, ginger, garlic, lemon juice and salt.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Heat the coconut oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the steaks for 4 minutes each side until crisp and opaque.
Serve with the rice and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C. Contains fish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 20 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Kolkata Mutton Biryani with Potato and Egg
recipes.summary: Mild, fragrant biryani with tender lamb, golden potato and boiled egg, a Calcutta speciality.
steps: Brown the potatoes in 1 tbsp ghee for 8 minutes until golden, then lift out. Fry the onions in the same pot for 10 minutes until golden.
Add the lamb, yoghurt, ginger, garlic, garam masala and salt and cook covered for 40 minutes on low heat until the lamb is tender.
Boil the rice in salted water for 6 minutes until three-quarters cooked, then drain.
Layer the rice over the lamb, tucking the potatoes and eggs in, and drizzle with the saffron milk and remaining ghee.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes until the rice is tender and fluffy.
notes: Food safety: lamb must reach at least 71°C; simmered until tender it will. Boil the eggs until the yolk is firm. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Thalassery Chicken Biryani Malabar
recipes.summary: Malabar biryani of masala chicken under short-grain khaima rice, with fried onion, cashews and raisins.
steps: Fry the cashews and sultanas in 1 tbsp ghee for 1 minute until golden, then lift out. Fry two-thirds of the onion in the same pot for 12 minutes until deep gold.
Add the ginger, garlic, tomatoes, chillies, spices and salt and cook for 8 minutes into a thick masala.
Add the chicken, cover and cook for 20 minutes on low heat until tender; lift out.
Stir the rice into the masala with the stock, bring to the boil, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes until the rice is tender and fluffy.
Layer the chicken over the rice, scatter with the cashews, sultanas and remaining onion, and rest covered for 10 minutes.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach at least 75°C at the thickest part. Contains tree nuts and milk. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Kacchi Gosht Biryani Bangladeshi Raw-Marinated Lamb
recipes.summary: Lamb marinated in yoghurt and spices, layered raw with part-cooked rice and sealed to steam in its own juices.

items: 2 onions, sliced and fried until golden

steps: Mix the lamb with the yoghurt, ginger, garlic, chilli powder, garam masala, half the onions and the salt.
Boil the rice in salted water for 6 minutes until three-quarters cooked, then drain.
In a heavy pot, layer the potatoes, then the lamb and its marinade, then the rice, ghee, remaining onion and milk.
Seal the lid with foil or a tight cloth and cook on high for 5 minutes, then on the lowest heat for 70 minutes, until the lamb is tender.
Rest for 10 minutes before opening and serve.
notes: Food safety: lamb must reach at least 71°C and be fully tender before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 4 hours marinating.

recipes.title: Ambur Star Chicken Biryani
recipes.summary: Tamil Nadu biryani with a green chilli, mint and tomato masala and plenty of fragrant basmati.
steps: Fry the onions in the oil for 10 minutes until golden.
Add the ginger, garlic, chillies, mint and tomatoes and cook for 8 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the chicken, yoghurt, chilli powder, garam masala and salt and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the water and rice, bring to the boil, then cover and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes until the rice is tender and fluffy.
Rest covered for 10 minutes, then fluff and serve.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach at least 75°C at the thickest part. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Bihari Kebab Smoky Beef Strips
recipes.summary: Thin beef strips tenderised in yoghurt and lemon and grilled hot with a smoky, spicy crust.

items: 700g beef sirloin, cut into thin strips

steps: Mix the beef with the yoghurt, lemon juice, ginger, garlic, spices and salt.
Thread the strips onto skewers in loose folds and brush with the oil.
Grill over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes each side, until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Warm the naan and serve with the kebabs and onion.
notes: Food safety: beef strips must reach at least 71°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 2 hours marinating.

recipes.title: Lahori Fried Fish
recipes.summary: Spiced fish pieces in a thin chickpea batter, shallow-fried and served with lemon and a crunchy salad.

items: 600g firm white fish fillets, cut into 4cm pieces

steps: Mix the chickpea flour, spices, salt and lemon juice with enough water for a thick batter.
Coat the fish pieces in the batter.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat and fry the fish for 3 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper and serve with the cabbage, tomato and lemon.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C. Contains fish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tabaka Uzbek Flattened Chicken with Garlic
recipes.summary: Whole spatchcocked chicken pressed flat, seared and roasted until crisp, with garlic and potatoes.
steps: Rub the chicken with the butter, garlic, coriander, paprika, salt and pepper.
Sear skin-side down in the oil in a large oven-safe pan for 8 minutes until golden, with a heavy pan pressed on top.
Turn the chicken, add the potatoes around it and roast at 220C for 35 minutes until the skin is crisp and the potatoes are tender.
Rest for 10 minutes, then carve.
Stir the dill into the yoghurt and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach at least 75°C at the thickest part of the thigh. Wash hands and board after raw chicken. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Samarkand Lamb Shashlik with Onion Salad
recipes.summary: Cubes of lamb leg marinated in onion and vinegar, grilled hot and served with flatbread and a tomato onion salad.
steps: Mix the lamb with the grated onions, vinegar, cumin, salt, pepper and oil.
Thread onto skewers and grill over high heat for 12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Toss the tomatoes, red onion and coriander together.
Serve the lamb on the flatbread with the salad.
notes: Food safety: lamb must reach at least 71°C; cut one cube to check. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 2 hours marinating.

recipes.title: Mutton Sukka Dry Pepper Lamb
recipes.summary: Tender lamb slow-cooked until dry and coated in a toasted black pepper, fennel and coriander masala.
steps: Toast the coriander, peppercorns and fennel in a dry pan for 2 minutes, then grind with the coconut.
Fry the onions in the oil for 10 minutes until golden, then add the ginger, garlic and tomatoes and cook for 8 minutes into a paste.
Add the lamb, turmeric, salt and ground masala with 1 cup of water, cover and cook on low for 50 minutes until the lamb is tender.
Uncover and stir over high heat for 8 minutes until the liquid has gone and the meat is coated and dark.
notes: Food safety: lamb must reach at least 71°C and be tender before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Kozhi Varuval Kerala Pepper Fried Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken fried with plenty of shallot, ginger and black pepper until dry and glossy, served with rice.
steps: Rub the chicken with the turmeric, salt and half the pepper.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat, fry the onions for 10 minutes until golden, then add the ginger, garlic and coriander.
Add the chicken, cover and cook for 15 minutes, then uncover and fry for 8 minutes until dry and browned.
Stir through the remaining pepper and garam masala and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach at least 75°C at the thickest part. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Prawn Balchao Goan Pickled Prawns
recipes.summary: Fried prawns folded through a tangy, fiery Goan vinegar masala and served with rice.
steps: Blend the soaked chillies, garlic, ginger, cumin and vinegar to a paste.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Fry the onions in 2 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until golden, add the paste, sugar and salt and cook for 5 minutes until the oil rises.
In a separate pan, fry the prawns in the remaining oil for 3 minutes until pink and opaque.
Fold the prawns into the masala for 2 minutes and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque, at least 63°C. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tawa Machhi Mumbai Pan-Fried Spiced Fish
recipes.summary: Fish fillets in a green chilli, coriander and lemon rub, seared on a flat pan and served with warm rotis.
steps: Blend the coriander, chillies, ginger, garlic, lemon juice, turmeric and salt into a thick paste.
Coat the fish in the paste.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat and sear the fish for 4 minutes each side until opaque and golden.
Warm the rotis and serve with the fish and onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C. Contains fish and gluten. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 15 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Kala Bhuna Chittagong Black Beef
recipes.summary: Chittagong beef slow-cooked until dark, dry and intense with mustard oil, onion and roasted spices.
steps: Heat the mustard oil in a heavy pot until it just smokes, then lower the heat and fry the onions for 12 minutes until dark brown.
Add the ginger, garlic, chilli, cumin, coriander, bay and salt and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the beef and 1/2 cup water, cover and cook on low for 90 minutes until very tender, stirring now and then.
Uncover and stir over medium heat for 10 minutes until the sauce clings and is very dark.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes, and serve with the beef finished with the garam masala.
notes: Food safety: beef must reach at least 71°C and be tender before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Murgh Kali Mirch Black Pepper Chicken
recipes.summary: Creamy yoghurt-marinated chicken with a heavy hand of freshly cracked black pepper, served with rice.

items: 700g boneless chicken thigh, cut into pieces

steps: Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, half the pepper, ginger, garlic and salt.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Fry the onion in the ghee for 8 minutes until golden, add the chicken and cook covered for 15 minutes on medium heat.
Stir in the cream and remaining pepper and cook for 3 minutes until glossy, then serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach at least 75°C at the thickest part. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 30 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Tandoori Gobi Roasted Spiced Cauliflower
recipes.summary: Whole florets coated in a chickpea flour and yoghurt marinade, roasted until charred, with chapatis and mint yoghurt.
steps: Mix the yoghurt, chickpea flour, ginger, garlic, chilli powder, garam masala, salt and oil.
Coat the cauliflower in the mix, turning well.
Roast on a tray at 230C for 25 minutes, turning once, until charred at the tips and tender.
Stir the mint through a little extra yoghurt.
Serve the cauliflower with the chapatis, mint yoghurt and lemon.
notes: Plus 30 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Kathi Roll Kolkata Chicken and Egg Roll
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken and egg wrapped in a flaky paratha with onion, lime and chutney, a Kolkata street classic.
steps: Toss the chicken with the ginger, garlic, garam masala, chilli powder and salt.
Fry in 2 tbsp oil over high heat for 6 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Fry the parathas in the remaining oil, spreading one side with beaten egg and cooking for 1 minute until the egg sets firm.
Fill with the chicken, onion, chutney and a squeeze of lime, and roll up tightly.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach at least 75°C at the thickest part and the egg be fully set. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 15 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Ping Gai Lao Grilled Lemongrass Chicken
recipes.summary: Lao-style grilled chicken thighs marinated in lemongrass, garlic and coriander root, served with sticky rice.
steps: Blend the lemongrass, garlic, coriander roots, fish sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and pepper into a paste, and coat the chicken.
Steam the rice, soaked beforehand, for 25 minutes until sticky and tender.
Brush the chicken with the oil and grill or roast at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once, until deeply golden.
Serve with the sticky rice and sweet chilli sauce.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach at least 75°C at the thickest part. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Plus 1 hour marinating and 4 hours soaking the rice.
